scope: ordinary friction or small superficial blister on non-sensitive skin; not deep, chemical, electrical, or extensive
patterns: I have a blister from new shoes
should I pop a heel blister
how do I cover a blister on my foot
response: Do not intentionally pop an intact blister. Protect it with a clean nonstick dressing and reduce the rubbing that caused it. If it opens on its own, gently wash it, leave the roof of skin in place if possible, and cover with a clean dressing.
red_flags: increasing redness, warmth, swelling, or pus
blister on the face, genitals, or inside the mouth
blister from a chemical, electrical, or significant burn
